verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a saved-template or snippet feature in Gmail, with or without variables and attachments. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: one-click suggested replies, Gemini AI drafting, add-ons that can create drafts, and API draft endpoints. Those are AI generation features or developer building blocks, not reusable user-saved templates.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
